happiness.title: Well-being Check-in
happiness.subtitle: Based on the PERMA-V Profiler (Butler & Kern, 2016), a scientifically validated well-being assessment.
happiness.description: 23 questions across Positive Emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Accomplishment, Negative Emotion, and Health. Takes about 5 minutes.
happiness.question: Question {current} of {total}

results.title: Your Well-being Profile
results.subtitle: PERMA-V Assessment Results
results.overallPERMADesc: Average of Positive Emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning & Accomplishment
results.citation: Butler, J. & Kern, M. L. (2016). The PERMA-Profiler: A brief multidimensional measure of flourishing. International Journal of Wellbeing, 6(3), 1–48.

P.label: Positive Emotion
P.description: How often you feel joy, gratitude, and contentment.

E.label: Engagement
E.description: How absorbed and energized you are by your activities.

R.label: Relationships
R.description: How supported, loved, and connected you feel.

M.label: Meaning
M.description: How purposeful and worthwhile your life feels.

A.label: Accomplishment
A.description: How often you achieve goals and make progress.

N.label: Negative Emotion
N.description: Frequency of anxiety, anger, and sadness (lower is better).

questions.1: How often do you feel joyful?
questions.2: How often do you feel positive?
questions.3: In general, how often do you feel contented?
questions.4: How often do you become absorbed in what you are doing?
questions.5: How often do you feel excited and interested in things?
questions.6: How often do you lose track of time while doing something you enjoy?
questions.7: To what extent do you receive help and support from others when you need it?
questions.8: To what extent do you feel loved?
questions.9: How satisfied are you with your personal relationships?
questions.10: In general, to what extent do you lead a purposeful and meaningful life?
questions.11: To what extent do you feel that what you do in your life is valuable and worthwhile?
questions.12: In general, to what extent do you feel you have a sense of direction in your life?
questions.13: How often do you achieve the important goals you have set for yourself?
questions.14: How often are you able to handle your responsibilities?
questions.15: How much of the time do you feel you are making progress towards your goals?
questions.16: How often do you feel anxious?
questions.17: How often do you feel angry?
questions.18: How often do you feel sad?
questions.19: In general, how would you rate your physical health?
questions.20: How often do you feel physically healthy and energetic?
questions.21: Compared to people your age, how is your overall health?
questions.22: Taking everything into account, how happy would you say you are?
questions.23: In general, how would you rate your overall well-being?
